claims.claim: Competition target is fault locations; predictions are not confirmed geothermal vents.
Metric is distance-weighted Tversky with alpha=.2, beta=.8 and a 300 m triangular support.
With G truth pixels, DTI=T/[.2(T+F)+.8G]; T+F is not generally emitted pixel count.
A submission has one float32 band, [0,1] confidence, EPSG:32611, 100 m, exact template grid, null/NaN outside.
Three contest submissions per week, one final entry across both rounds, AI-use disclosure and finalist reproducibility assets are required.
Initial requested leaderboard snapshot showed DARD .3195 and account wbg1 .2477, not filenames.
H25-1 scored .2477; H19-5 parent scored .1922.
The exact H25 raster is a 60069-pixel subset of the 121131-pixel parent; deterministic 1.5px operator reproduced pixel-for-pixel.
All 19 full-resolution stack bands were retained; six pretraining passes visited/masked every footprint pixel before raster label access.
claims.limit: 3061 in-footprint cells have no observed channel and cannot furnish target values; coverage means visit/mask, not invented data.
